verses.text: गाहमानमनीकानि युध्यमानं महारथैः । पाण्डवैरतितेजोभिर्लोकस्त्वामनुदृष्टवान् ॥
verses.english: The world saw you plunging into the armies [and] fighting with the great chariot-warriors, the Pāṇḍavas of surpassing splendour.
verses.gold_issues: DCS splits अति as separate ADP, but अतितेजोभिः is one bahuvrīhi (treated here as compound 6,7); form अनुदृष्टवन् should be अनुदृष्टवान्.

verses.text: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वा मासि मासि जनेश्वर । अभिगच्छन्ति तत्तीर्थं पुण्यं ब्राह्मणसेवितम् ॥
verses.english: O lord of men, there the gods together with the Gandharvas approach, month after month, that holy tīrtha frequented by brahmins.
verses.gold_issues: स of सगन्धर्वाः tagged as separate ADV; it is the first member of a bahuvrīhi (treated as compound 2,3). मासि मासि = vīpsā, both अधिकरण.

verses.text: अरण्ये यो विमुञ्चेत संग्रामे वा तनुं नरः । क्रतूनाहृत्य महतो महिमानं स गच्छति ॥
verses.english: The man who would give up [his] body in the forest or in battle, he, having performed great sacrifices, attains greatness.
verses.gold_issues: विमुञ्चेत tagged Person=2 Number=Plur; it is 3rd sg. optative ātmanepada. Relative clause (यः … विमुञ्चेत) headed to correlative सः.

verses.text: नातः पुण्यतरं दानं नातः पुण्यतरं फलम् । नातो विशिष्टं लोकेषु भूतं भवितुमर्हति ॥
verses.english: There is no gift holier than this, no fruit holier than this; nothing existing in the worlds can be more excellent than this.
verses.gold_issues: अतः = ablative of comparison "than this" (indeclinable), attached to the comparative. Three clauses; first two verbless.

verses.text: हुताशनज्वलितशिखोज्ज्वलत्प्रभमुपस्थितं शरदमलार्कतेजसम् । विराजते कमलमुदारवर्चसं महात्मनस्तनुरुहचारुदर्शनम् ॥

compounds.vigraha: हुताशनस्य ज्वलिताः शिखाः इव उज्ज्वलन्ती प्रभा यस्य तत्
शरदि अमलस्य अर्कस्य तेजः इव तेजः यस्य तत्
तनुरुहं च तत् चारु दर्शनं यस्य तत् च

verses.english: The lotus, grown from the body of the great-souled one [and] lovely to behold, whose radiance blazes like the kindled flames of fire, [now] present, having the brilliance of the spotless autumn sun, of noble lustre, shines.
verses.gold_issues: 4,5,9 tagged Acc but are neuter nominatives agreeing with कमलम्; lemma वर्चस should be वर्चस्. महात्मनः (Viṣṇu) attached to compound member तनुरुह (sāpekṣa). तनुरुह taken as "grown from the body" (navel-lotus) rather than "hair" – uncertain.

verses.text: को हि मे भोक्तुकामस्य विघ्नं चरति दुर्मतिः । न बिभेषि हिडिम्बे किं मत्कोपाद्विप्रमोहिता ॥
verses.english: Who indeed, evil-minded, makes an obstacle for me who wish to eat? O Hiḍimbā, deluded, do you not fear my anger?
verses.gold_issues: मत्कोपात् = ablative of the feared with भी (अपादान). विप्रमोहिता qualifies the unexpressed subject त्वम्, so headed to the verb. भोक्तु is the infinitive stem in compound (tagged NOUN).

verses.text: विहगाश्च मुदा युक्ताः प्रानृत्यन्व्यनदंश्च ह । गिरिपृष्ठेषु रम्येषु व्याहरन्तो जनप्रियाः ॥
verses.english: And the birds, filled with joy, dear to people, calling out on the lovely mountain-ridges, danced and cried aloud.
verses.gold_issues: two coordinated finite verbs sharing the subject, each given its own clause head.

verses.text: एकादशचमूभर्ता सो ऽहमेतां दशां गतः । कालं प्राप्य महाबाहो न कश्चिदतिवर्तते ॥
verses.english: I, that lord of eleven armies, have come to this state; O mighty-armed one, having met [his] time, no one passes beyond [it].
verses.gold_issues: गतः is a क्त predicate with nominative agent (गत्यर्थ, कर्तरि क्त).

verses.text: चिन्तयञ्जलमध्यस्थो मार्कण्डेयो विशङ्कितः । किं नु स्यान्मम चिन्तेयं मोहः स्वप्नोऽनुभूयते ॥
verses.english: Mārkaṇḍeya, standing in the midst of the water, alarmed, pondering: "What could this be? Is this my imagination, a delusion, [or] a dream that is being experienced?"
verses.gold_issues: no finite main verb in the verse; the participle चिन्तयन् is taken as predicate, the quoted clauses headed to it. चिन्ता, मोहः, स्वप्नः taken as alternative nominative subjects of the passive अनुभूयते (कर्म by convention).

verses.text: तावच्चात्र प्रतिष्ठाने प्राविशत्तस्य सा प्रिया । चिरप्रविष्टं तं कान्तं वीक्षितुं देवसद्म तत् ॥
verses.english: And meanwhile, here in Pratiṣṭhāna, his beloved entered that temple of the god to see her husband, who had entered long before.
verses.gold_issues: प्रिया (ADJ) used substantively = beloved wife; कान्त likewise = husband.

verses.text: महानात्मा मतिर्विष्णुर्विश्वः शंभुश्च वीर्यवान् । बुद्धिः प्रज्ञोपलब्धिश्च तथा ख्यातिर्धृतिः स्मृतिः ॥
verses.english: Mahat, Ātman, Mati, Viṣṇu, Viśva and the mighty Śambhu, Buddhi, Prajñā and Upalabdhi, and likewise Khyāti, Dhṛti, Smṛti [are its names].
verses.gold_issues: verbless list of synonyms; the first name taken as head, the rest as appositions (विशेषण). Form महन्त् should be महान् (lemma महत्).

verses.text: नित्योदको ब्राह्मणः स्यान्नित्यशस्त्रश्च क्षत्रियः । तयोर्हि सर्वमायत्तं यत्किंचिज्जगतीगतम् ॥
verses.english: A brahmin should be ever with water [at hand], and a kṣatriya ever with [his] weapon; for whatever has come to be on earth, all [of it] depends on those two.
verses.gold_issues: क्षत्रियः shares स्यात् (headed to it). आयत्तम् is the participial predicate; relative clause यत्किंचित् … गतम् headed to सर्वम्.

verses.text: अर्चयित्वा जामदग्न्यं पूजितस्तेन चाभिभूः । महेन्द्र उष्य तां रात्रिं प्रययौ दक्षिणामुखः ॥
verses.english: Having worshipped Jāmadagnya [and] been honoured by him, [the mighty one], having stayed that night on Mahendra, set out facing south.
verses.gold_issues: the text has च अभिभूः after तेन, missing from the gold word list (subject therefore unexpressed; पूजितः, दक्षिणामुखः headed to the verb). रात्रिम् is accusative of duration (कालाध्वनोरत्यन्तसंयोगे), marked कर्म of उष्य. तेन = agent of the passive participle, marked कर्ता.

verses.text: याचकेभ्यो ददौ नित्यं वित्तं यावच्च यच्च सः । दृष्टा मदनमाला सा तत्तस्मै स्वमुपानयत् ॥
verses.english: He constantly gave wealth to beggars, as much as and whatever [he had]; that Madanamālā, [being] seen [thus], brought her own [wealth] to him.
verses.gold_issues: दृष्टा (participle "seen") is odd; probably a corruption of दृष्ट्वा "having seen [this]" – annotated as written. यावत् here an adverbial "as much as", not a conjunction.

verses.text: शराणां धनुषश्चाहमनृणो ऽस्मि महावने । ससैन्यं भरतं हत्वा भविष्यामि न संशयः ॥
verses.english: I am free of debt to [my] arrows and bow in the great forest; having slain Bharata with [his] army I shall be [so]; [there is] no doubt.
verses.gold_issues: ऽस्मि is probably अस्मिन् ("in this great forest") with भविष्यामि as the only verb; gold reads the verb अस्मि. स of ससैन्यम् split as ADV (treated as compound 8,9). सैन्य tagged Masc (as part of bahuvrīhi agreeing with भरतम्).

verses.text: पुरा विकुर्वते मूढाः पापात्मानः समागताः । धर्षिताः काममन्युभ्यां क्रोधलोभवशानुगाः ॥

compounds.vigraha: क्रोधलोभयोः (क्रोधः च लोभः च) वशम् अनुगच्छन्ति इति

verses.english: Formerly the deluded, wicked-souled [ones], assembled, overpowered by desire and anger, following the sway of wrath and greed, behave perversely.
verses.gold_issues: काममन्युभ्याम् = agent of the passive participle धर्षिताः (marked कर्ता).

verses.text: आकाशे विद्रुमे पुण्ये प्रस्थे हिमवतः शुभे । अरुणां सरस्वतीं प्राप्य पपुः सस्नुश्च तज्जलम् ॥
verses.english: On the open, treeless, holy, lovely plateau of the Himavat, having reached the red Sarasvatī, they drank and bathed in that water.
verses.gold_issues: form हिमवन्तस् should be हिमवतः (lemma हिमवत्); आकाश/विद्रुम tagged Neut, शुभ/प्रस्थ Masc for one locative phrase (प्रस्थ is m./n.). जलम् serves both पपुः and सस्नुः (headed to पपुः).

verses.text: दक्षिणाग्निर्यदा द्वाभ्यां संसृजेत तदा किल । इष्टिरष्टाकपालेन कार्या वै वीतये ऽग्नये ॥
verses.english: When the southern fire mixes with the two [other fires], then indeed an offering with an eight-sherd [cake] must be made to Agni Vīti.
verses.gold_issues: अष्टाकपाल (lexicalised) used substantively for the cake (पुरोडाश). इष्टिः is the nominative object of the gerundive कार्या (कर्म by convention).

verses.text: मन्त्रिणामुदपद्यन्त सर्वेषां शुभलक्षणाः । क्रमेण तनयास्तत्र भाविकल्याणसूचकाः ॥
verses.english: There, in due course, sons were born to all the ministers, bearing auspicious marks [and] foretelling future welfare.
verses.gold_issues: genitive मन्त्रिणाम् "to/of the ministers" taken as सम्बन्ध to तनयाः.

verses.text: शमीकं च महात्मानं पुत्रं तं चास्य शृङ्गिणम् । अमात्या ये बभूवुश्च राज्ञस्तांश्च ददर्श ह ॥
verses.english: And he saw the great-souled Śamīka, and that son of his, Śṛṅgin, and those who were the king's ministers.
verses.gold_issues: relative clause ये … बभूवुः headed to correlative तान्; अमात्याः is its predicate nominative.

verses.text: तं हत्वा पुण्डरीकाक्षो नदन्तं दन्तिनां वरम् । अवतीर्णो ऽर्णवाकारं समाजं सहपूर्वजः ॥

compounds.vigraha: अर्णवस्य आकारः इव आकारः यस्य तम्

verses.english: Having killed him, the roaring best of elephants, the lotus-eyed one, together with [his] elder brother, descended into the ocean-like assembly.
verses.gold_issues: सह of सहपूर्वजः split as ADV; it is a bahuvrīhi (treated as compound 10,11). अवतीर्णः = कर्तरि क्त predicate.

verses.text: सयज्ञाः सक्रिया वेदाः प्रत्यानीता हि तेन वै । चातुर्वर्ण्यमसंकीर्णं कृतं तेन महात्मना ॥
verses.english: For indeed by him the Vedas, together with sacrifices and rites, were brought back; by that great-souled one the four-class order was made unmixed.
verses.gold_issues: स/स/अ split as separate words (treated as compound members). क्रियास् tagged Masc (agrees as bahuvrīhi with वेदाः). असंकीर्णम् = predicative complement of कृतम्.

verses.text: कैकेय्यां मुक्तलज्जायां वदन्त्यामतिदारुणम् । राजा दशरथो वाक्यमुवाचायतलोचनाम् । वहन्तं किं तुदसि मां नियुज्य धुरि माहिते ॥
verses.english: When Kaikeyī, having cast off shame, was speaking very harshly, King Daśaratha spoke [these] words to the long-eyed one: "Having yoked me to the yoke laid [on me], why do you goad me while I am pulling?"
verses.gold_issues: locative absolute (सति सप्तमी) कैकेय्यां … वदन्त्याम्. अति split as ADP (treated as प्रादि compound 4,5). Gold form वदत्याम् should be वदन्त्याम्. माहिते read by gold as माम् आहिते; आहिते (Masc) does not agree with धुरि (Fem) – perhaps मा अहिते "O unfriendly one" (voc.); followed gold. Direct speech headed to उवाच, placed after it. किम् = "why" (अव्यय).

verses.text: विवर्धता बलवता वेगाद्विक्षोभितोऽर्णवः । तस्यार्णवस्य क्षुब्धस्य तस्मिन्नम्भसि मन्थिते । कृष्णवर्त्मा समभवत्प्रभुर्वैश्वानरो महान् ॥
verses.english: The ocean was stirred up with force by the growing, mighty [one]; when that water of that agitated ocean was churned, the lord, great Vaiśvānara, the black-trailed [fire], came into being.
verses.gold_issues: विवर्धता used substantively as agent of the क्त predicate (referent from context). Locative absolute (सति सप्तमी) तस्मिन् अम्भसि मन्थिते. वेगात् = ablative of manner/cause.

verses.text: सौमित्रिस्तु परं दैन्यं जगाम सुमहामतिः । रामपादौ समासाद्य वक्ष्यामि किमहं गतः ॥
verses.english: But Saumitri, of very great mind, fell into extreme dejection: "Having reached Rāma's feet, what shall I, having gone [there], say?"
verses.gold_issues: सु split as ADV (treated as compound member). परम् tagged PRON; it is an adjective here. The thought (वक्ष्यामि …) has no verb of saying, given its own clause head.

verses.text: निशाचराणि भूतानि गृहेषु गृहदेवताः । यानि चान्यानि भूतानि जानीयुर्भाषितं तव ॥
verses.english: The night-roaming beings, the house-deities in the houses, and whatever other beings [there are] may know your speech.
verses.gold_issues: text has तव, gold form ते. यानि … अन्यानि भूतानि is an elliptic relative ("whatever other beings"), treated as a co-subject.

verses.text: एवं ख्यातो नरपते लोके ऽस्मिन्स वनस्पतिः । तत्र तीर्थं सरस्वत्याः पावनं लोकविश्रुतम् ॥
verses.english: O lord of men, that tree is thus famed in this world; there [is] the purifying, world-renowned tīrtha of the Sarasvatī.
verses.gold_issues: ख्यातः is the participial predicate; second half is a verbless existential clause.

verses.text: धारणा चैव मनसः प्राणायामश्च पार्थिव । प्राणायामो हि सगुणो निर्गुणं धारणं मनः ॥
verses.english: O king, [there are] concentration of the mind and breath-control; for breath-control is with qualities, [while] concentration, [i.e.] the mind, is without qualities.
verses.gold_issues: verbless clauses. प्राणायामः (4) is coordinated with धारणा and headed to it. मनः (Nom) beside धारणम् is awkward – perhaps for मनसः; taken as apposition. स of सगुणः split as ADV (treated as compound member).

verses.text: नीलकण्ठपरिभुक्तयौवनां तां विलोक्य जननी समाश्वसत् । भर्तृवल्लभतया हि मानसीं मातुरस्यति शुचं वधूजनः ॥
verses.english: Seeing her, whose youth had been enjoyed by the Blue-throated one, the mother was comforted; for a young bride, by being dear to [her] husband, casts off the mental grief of [her] mother.
verses.gold_issues: gold duplicates tokens: भर्तृ (7,8), वल्लभ (9,10), तया as PRON (11) and as suffix ता (12) for one word भर्तृवल्लभतया; all treated as members of one form ending in 12. Gold मानसाम् should be मानसीम् (text). तया = instrumental of cause (करण).

verses.text: पुत्रं च शंभवे चैकं समुत्पादितवानृषिः । तस्याग्रे वाग्यतस्तस्थौ ब्रह्मा तामसमव्ययम् ॥
verses.english: And the sage produced for Śambhu one son, of tāmasa nature [and] imperishable; Brahmā stood before him, restraining [his] speech.
verses.gold_issues: तामसम् अव्ययम् have no governor in the second half; taken as qualifying पुत्रम् (uncertain; they may be the object of a verb in the next verse). Form समुत्पादितवन् should be समुत्पादितवान्. वाग्यत kept as one word by gold.

verses.text: अध्यात्मगतचित्तो यस्तन्मनास्तत्परायणः । युक्तो योगं प्रति सदा प्रतिसंख्यानमेव च ॥
verses.english: He who [is one] whose mind has gone to the inner self, whose mind is on That, who has That as [his] highest goal, ever devoted to yoga and to discrimination as well …
verses.gold_issues: verbless relative clause; its main clause is in a neighbouring verse, so यः heads it. योगम् is governed by the karmapravacanīya प्रति (marked कर्म of युक्तः). प्रतिसंख्यानम् tagged Nom; read as accusative coordinated with योगम्.

verses.text: अहमप्यत्र ते दद्मि वरं शस्त्रभृतां वर । अर्घ्यं प्रतिगृहाणेदमयोध्यां श्वो गमिष्यसि ॥
verses.english: O best of weapon-bearers, I too here give you a boon. Accept this guest-offering; tomorrow you will go to Ayodhyā.
verses.gold_issues: दद्मि is an epic/irregular form for ददामि. वर (boon) tagged Neut (normally Masc). शस्त्रभृत् kept as one word by gold. अयोध्याम् = accusative of goal (कर्म).

verses.text: यद्भैक्षमाचरिष्याम वृष्ण्यन्धकपुरे वयम् । ज्ञातीन्निष्पुरुषान्कृत्वा नेमां प्राप्स्याम दुर्गतिम् ॥
verses.english: If we had practised begging in the city of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas, we, having made [our] kinsmen bereft of men, would not have reached this evil plight.
verses.gold_issues: conditional (लृङ्) in protasis and apodosis; protasis headed to the main verb. निष्पुरुषान् = predicative complement of कृत्वा (विधेय).

verses.text: प्रहसंश्चाब्रवीद्वाक्यं चेदिराजः प्रतापवान् । भीमसेनमतिक्रुद्धं दृष्ट्वा भीमपराक्रमम् ॥
verses.english: And the valiant king of the Cedis, having seen Bhīmasena, of terrible prowess, extremely enraged, laughing, spoke [these] words.
verses.gold_issues: अति split as ADP (treated as प्रादि compound member). राज = समासान्त टच् form of राजन्.

verses.text: यो नरः प्राप्यते तत्र रात्रौ सह परस्त्रिया । स्थाप्यते सो ऽस्य यक्षस्य गर्भागारे तया समम् ॥
verses.english: The man who is caught there at night with another's wife, he is placed together with her in the inner chamber of this Yakṣa.
verses.gold_issues: passive verbs: नरः and सः are nominative objects (कर्म). Relative clause headed to correlative सः. परस्त्रिया = instrumental of accompaniment with सह.

verses.text: तदा च हरिशर्मात्र तद्गृहे सकुटुम्बकः । आकण्ठघृतमांसादिभोजनास्थां बबन्ध सः ॥

compounds.vigraha: आकण्ठं (अव्ययीभाव) घृतमांसादीनां (घृतं मांसं च आदौ येषां तेषाम्) भोजने आस्था

verses.english: And then Hariśarman, with [his] family, here in his house, set [his] hope on eating ghee, meat and the like up to the throat.
verses.gold_issues: स of सकुटुम्बकः and आ of आकण्ठ split by gold as separate ADV/ADP; treated as compound members. आस्थां बबन्ध = "set his heart on".

verses.text: महादेव उवाच । नाघं प्रजेश बालानां वर्णये नानुचिन्तये । देवमायाभिभूतानां दण्डस्तत्र धृतो मया ॥
verses.english: Mahādeva said: "O lord of creatures, I do not recount the offence of children, nor do I brood on [it]; the rod was held by me there for those overcome by the god's māyā."
verses.gold_issues: direct speech clauses headed to उवाच. देवमायाभिभूतानाम् is a genitive of interest (सम्बन्ध to दण्डः).

verses.text: अमात्येषु च भिन्नेषु योधेषु विमुखेषु च । पुनरेकाग्रकरणं तेषां कर्म भविष्यति ॥
verses.english: And when the ministers are divided and the warriors averse, the task will be to make them single-minded again.
verses.gold_issues: two locative absolutes (सति सप्तमी), the predicative adjectives heading their nouns. तेषाम् = object-genitive of the verbal noun करणम् (सम्बन्ध).

verses.text: अत्रापि प्रधानाङ्गं राजा । अथ कुक्कुटेनागत्य राजहंसस्य शरीरे खरतरनखाघातः कृतः । तदा सत्वरमुपसृत्य सारसेन स्वदेहान्तरितो राजा जले क्षिप्तः । अथ कुक्कुटनखप्रहारजर्जरीकृतेनापि सारसेन कुक्कुटसेना बहुशो हता । पश्चात्सारसो ऽपि बहुभिः पक्षिभिः समेत्य चञ्चुप्रहारेण विभिद्य व्यापादितः । अथ चित्रवर्णो दुर्गं प्रविश्य दुर्गावस्थितं द्रव्यं ग्राहयित्वा वन्दिभिर्जयशब्दैरानन्दितः स्वस्कन्धावारं जगाम । अथ राजपुत्रैरुक्तं तस्मिन्राजहंसपक्षे पुण्यवान्स सारस एव येन स्वदेहत्यागेन स्वामी रक्षितः । यतः । जनयन्ति सुतान्गावः सर्वा एव गवाकृतीन् । विषाणोल्लिखितस्कन्धं काचिदेव गवां पतिम् ॥

compounds.vigraha: गोः आकृतिः इव आकृतिः येषां तान्

verses.english: Here too the king is the principal limb. Then the cock, having come, made a blow with very sharp claws on the body of the royal swan. Then the crane, having approached swiftly, threw the king, screened by his own body, into the water. Then the crane, even though battered by the blows of the cock's claws, killed the cock-army in great numbers. Afterwards the crane too was killed by many birds, [who], having assembled, [and] having pierced [him] with beak-blows, [killed him]. Then Citravarṇa, having entered the fort [and] having had the wealth lying in the fort seized, gladdened by bards with cries of victory, went to his own camp. Then it was said by the princes: "On that side of the royal swan, that crane alone is meritorious, by whom, through the sacrifice of his own body, [his] master was protected." For: All cows bear sons having the form of cattle; only some [cow bears] a lord of cows, whose shoulder is scored by horns.
verses.gold_issues: क्त predicates with instrumental agents throughout (कृतः, क्षिप्तः, हता, व्यापादितः, उक्तम् impersonal). स of सत्वरम् split as ADV (treated as compound member; adverbial neuter). Gold forms सारसेण (×2) should be सारसेन; गो (84) for compound form गव. वन्दिन् tagged ADJ (noun "bard"). Elliptical last clause (काचित् … पतिम्) shares जनयन्ति. Quoted verbless clause headed by its subject to उक्तम्.

verses.text: जाने ऽहमेतद्वश्यायाः पित्रोः शक्यं तु किं मम । सर्वज्ञा सप्रभावा च तत्त्वमेवात्र मे गतिः ॥
verses.english: I know this; but what is possible for me, subject [as I am] to [my] parents? [You], all-knowing and powerful, [you] alone are my refuge here.
verses.gold_issues: gold makes एतद् a compound member of एतद्वश्यायाः; read here as separate object एतत् of जाने (वश्यायाः governs पित्रोः). Gold तत्त्वम् ("truth") is better split तत् त्वम् ("so you") – annotated on the gold token with the reading "you" (fem. सर्वज्ञा, सप्रभावा agree with an addressee). मम = genitive agent of the gerundive शक्यम् (सम्बन्ध). स of सप्रभावा split as ADV; प्रभावा tagged NOUN Fem (bahuvrīhi).

verses.text: भानुं दक्षिणतो देवं चतुर्वक्त्रं च पूर्ववत् । रविमुत्तरतो ऽपश्यन्पूर्ववच्चतुराननम् ॥
verses.english: They saw the god Bhānu to the south and the four-faced one as before, Ravi to the north [and] the four-faced one as before.
verses.gold_issues: वक्त्र tagged Masc (as bahuvrīhi final agreeing with Brahmā).

verses.text: निर्दोषा प्रतिभा ह्येनं कृत्स्ना समभिवर्तते । तथैव व्यक्तमात्मानमव्यक्तं प्रतिपद्यते ॥
verses.english: For flawless, complete insight comes to him; likewise he attains the manifest self [and] the unmanifest.
verses.gold_issues: अव्यक्तम् tagged Nom; it is accusative object of प्रतिपद्यते (or qualifies आत्मानम् with gender mismatch). Subject of the second clause unexpressed.

verses.text: शतक्रतुमुखैर्देवैः श्रूयते न पराजितः । महात्मा बलसम्पन्नो रावणो लोकरावणः ॥
verses.english: The great-souled Rāvaṇa, endowed with strength, who makes the worlds cry out, is heard [to be] undefeated by the gods headed by Śatakratu.
verses.gold_issues: रावणः is the nominative of the passive श्रूयते (कर्म by convention); पराजितः its predicate; न negates the participle. देवैः = agent of पराजितः.

verses.text: तृतीयं चास्य सम्भूतं नेत्रमादित्यसंनिभम् । युगान्तसदृशं दीप्तं येनासौ मथितो गिरिः ॥
verses.english: And his third eye came into being, like the sun, blazing, resembling the end of an age, by which that mountain was churned.
verses.gold_issues: सम्भूतम् = participial predicate. Relative clause (येन … मथितः गिरिः) headed to नेत्रम्; येन = agent of the क्त predicate.

verses.text: महानप्येकजो वृक्षो बलवान्सुप्रतिष्ठितः । प्रसह्य एव वातेन शाखास्कन्धं विमर्दितुम् ॥
verses.english: Even a great tree standing alone, strong, well-rooted – the wind, by force, [is able] to crush [its] branches and trunk.
verses.gold_issues: the governing word of the infinitive (e.g. शक्यः) is in a neighbouring verse, so विमर्दितुम् heads the clause; the nominative वृक्षः is the topic (whole) whose part शाखास्कन्धम् is the object. सु split as ADV (treated as compound member).

verses.text: बलमात्मनि पश्यन्ती न मां शङ्कितुमर्हसि । करिष्यामि तव प्रीतिं सुकृतेनापि ते शपे ॥
verses.english: Seeing strength in yourself, you should not suspect me. I will do what pleases you; I swear to you even by [my] good deeds.
verses.gold_issues: gold form पश्यती should be पश्यन्ती; it qualifies the unexpressed subject (headed to the verb). Text has तव, gold ते (8). ते (12) tagged Gen; with शप् "swear to" it is dative.

verses.text: पद्मकूटमिति ख्यातं पद्मवर्णं महाप्रभम् । सुभीमाया महाकूटं वासं सुपरमार्चितम् ॥

compounds.vigraha: पद्मस्य वर्णः इव वर्णः यस्य तत्

verses.english: [There is] a great peak, known as 'Padmakūṭa', lotus-coloured, of great radiance, the abode of Subhīmā, most highly worshipped.
verses.gold_issues: case mismatch in gold: first half Nom Neut, second half Acc Masc (कूट, वास, अर्चित). Taken as one verbless descriptive phrase headed by महाकूटम्; it may instead be the accusative object of a verb in a neighbouring verse. सु split as ADV (treated as compound member). पद्मकूटम् = name with इति, predicate of ख्यातम्.

verses.text: अव्यक्ताय च महते भूतादेरिन्द्रियाय च । आत्मज्ञाय विशेषाय तुभ्यं सर्वात्मने नमः ॥
verses.english: Homage to you, the Unmanifest, and the Great [principle] of the bhūtādi, and the sense-faculty, the knower of the self, the particular, the self of all.
verses.gold_issues: verbless "नमः [अस्तु]" with dative (नमःस्वस्ति…); नमः taken as subject. Gold form महन्ते should be महते (lemma महत्); text has तुभ्यम्, gold ते. भूतादेः (gen) is odd among datives – attached to महते, uncertain.

verses.text: संजय उवाच । ततो ऽब्रवीन्महाबाहुर्द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः । एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वं न मिथ्यास्तीति किंचन ॥
verses.english: Sañjaya said: Then the mighty-armed Droṇa, best of weapon-bearers, said: "As you say this, so [it is]; nothing is false [in it]."
verses.gold_issues: the narrative and the quoted clauses are headed to the verb of saying. Verbless correlative clause headed by एवम्; यथा-clause headed to it. आत्थ tagged Past (perfect with present sense).

verses.text: निर्गुणाय गुणज्ञाय व्याकृतायामृताय च । निरुपाख्याय मित्राय तुभ्यं सांख्यात्मने नमः ॥
verses.english: Homage to you, the quality-less, the knower of the qualities, the manifested and the immortal, the indescribable, the friend, the self of the Sāṅkhyas.
verses.gold_issues: text has तुभ्यम्, gold ते. नमः taken as subject of a verbless clause. अमृत tagged Neut but agrees with masc. datives.

verses.text: समुद्रनिग्रहादीनि चक्रे वीर्याण्यतः परम् । एकोनविंशे विंशतिमे वृष्णिषु प्राप्य जन्मनी ॥
verses.english: After this, having obtained two births among the Vṛṣṇis, in the nineteenth [and] the twentieth [incarnations], he performed heroic deeds such as the restraining of the ocean.
verses.gold_issues: परम् (tagged PRON) is an adverbial "after" with अतः (ablative sense). Subject unexpressed (the Lord). The two locatives are ordinal "in the 19th, 20th [avatāra]".

verses.text: छित्त्वा शक्तिं ततो भीमो निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभाम् । मार्गमाण इव प्राणान्सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष ॥
verses.english: O venerable one, then Bhīma, having cut the spear that resembled a snake freed [from its slough], [was] as if searching for the life-breaths of the charioteer's son.
verses.gold_issues: no finite verb; the participle मार्गमाणः taken as predicate. इव follows its standard मार्गमाणः.

verses.text: ते चाप्यभ्यवदत्प्रेम्णा देवमाता यशस्विनी । यथावदब्रवीच्चैव जनार्दनमिदं वचः ॥
verses.english: And the glorious mother of the gods greeted those two with affection, and spoke these words fittingly to Janārdana.
verses.gold_issues: ब्रू with two accusatives (जनार्दनम्, वचः). प्रेमन् tagged Masc (m./n.).

verses.text: मङ्गल्यपूर्वाः स्वाचारदक्षिणा नर्तितापराः । सत्प्राभृतोत्तरास्तैस्तैः सुरक्षिभिरधिष्ठिताः ॥
verses.english: [They], beginning with auspicious rites, having good conduct as [their] fee, with dancing after, ending with fine presents, were superintended by those various good guardians.
verses.gold_issues: the feminine plural subject is in a neighbouring verse; epithets headed to the participial predicate अधिष्ठिताः. सु split as ADV twice (treated as compound members). दक्षिणाः could also be adj. "skilled in good conduct" – uncertain. रक्षिन् tagged ADJ (noun "guard").

verses.text: मा नाम वृक्षमारूढा सा भवेदिति तत्क्षणम् । एको ऽस्य वणिजो भृत्यस्तरुमारोहति स्म तम् ॥
verses.english: Thinking "may she not, surely, have climbed the tree", at that very moment one servant of this merchant climbed that tree.
verses.gold_issues: तत्क्षणम् is an accusative of time (adverbial), marked अधिकरण. The इति-clause (apprehension) headed to the main verb. आरूढा = कर्तरि क्त predicate with भवेत्.

verses.text: तत्र चङ्क्रम्यमाणौ तौ वासुदेवसुतां शुभाम् । अलंकृतां सखीमध्ये भद्रां ददृशतुस्तदा ॥
verses.english: Then those two, roaming about there, saw the lovely, auspicious Bhadrā, Vāsudeva's daughter, adorned, in the midst of her friends.
verses.gold_issues: वासुदेव tagged ADJ (patronymic noun). सुता "daughter" with वासुदेव is odd (Subhadrā is Vasudeva's daughter); kept as written.

verses.text: अमृतं विषसंसृष्टं त्वया वानर भाषितम् । यच्च नान्यमना रामो यच्च शोकपरायणः ॥
verses.english: O monkey, nectar mixed with poison has been spoken by you: that Rāma [is] not of another mind, and that [he is] wholly given to grief.
verses.gold_issues: two verbless यत्-clauses (content clauses explaining "nectar" and "poison"); their subject रामः headed to the main verb. अमृतम् = nominative object of the क्त predicate (कर्म).

verses.text: मधोश्च तनयो दृप्तो लवणो नाम दानवः । हतो मधुवने भीमो वरदत्तो महासुरः । समरे युद्धशौण्डेन तथान्ये चापि राक्षसाः ॥
verses.english: And the son of Madhu, the arrogant Dānava named Lavaṇa, terrible, a great Asura to whom a boon had been granted, was slain in the Madhu forest, in battle, by the one keen in war, and likewise other Rākṣasas too.
verses.gold_issues: nominatives with the क्त predicate हतः are its objects (कर्म); युद्धशौण्डेन = agent. मधुवन kept as one word by gold. राक्षसाः share हतः (number mismatch, ellipsis of हताः).

verses.text: धर्मराजस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा यदुकुलोद्वहः । आमन्त्र्य दारुकं प्राह रथः सज्जो विधीयताम् ॥
verses.english: Having heard the words of the Dharma-king, the upholder of the Yadu race, having addressed Dāruka, said: "Let the chariot be made ready."
verses.gold_issues: यदुकुलोद्वह kept as one word by gold. Quoted passive imperative headed to प्राह; रथः its nominative object, सज्जः predicative.

verses.text: दशमे ऽहनि तस्मिंस्तु भीष्मार्जुनसमागमे । अवर्तत महारौद्रः सततं समितिक्षयः ॥

compounds.vigraha: भीष्मार्जुनयोः (भीष्मः च अर्जुनः च, द्वन्द्व) समागमः

verses.english: But on that tenth day, in the encounter of Bhīṣma and Arjuna, a very terrible destruction of the [assembled] host went on continuously.
verses.gold_issues: अहर् lemma for अहन्.
